name: beagle-context-management
description: Goose event wiring for the CORE Beagle context-management controller. This plugin carries NO logic and NO config — it only wires PostToolUse/Stop to the Python entrypoints in beagle/scripts/hooks/, which invoke beagle.context.compaction_controller (whose policy lives in the canonical config root, resolved by find_context_management_toml()). Context management is a core function, not a plugin.
